name: Kyocho Chuukou
source:
A young girl with pink hair who is a commander of the Gi kingdom. She is the only subordinate that [url=/c219]Sousou[/url] does not tease. She gets along with [url=/c204]Kazuto[/url] well and calls him "Onii-chan".
